name: Dataline.net.au
summary: Wholesale ISP/VISP provider (related to Australis Internet, World Publishing Systems); subject of 2002 ACCC action (unconscionable/misleading conduct, Federal Court 2003-07).

events.details: DATALINE.NET.AU PTY LTD ACN 075 400 529 registered 28 Aug 1996 (Stafford QLD 4053); founding member AACIP; ABN cancelled 23 Jul 2008 (per ABR).

refs.label: ABR: DATALINE.NET.AU PTY LTD ACN 075 400 529 (ABN cancelled 23 Jul 2008)

events.details: Website gone (no live site) — site collapsed to Apache directory listing between Jun and Sep 2006.

refs.label: Live Dataline VPN-branded homepage still served 13 Jun 2006.
By 10 Sep 2006 the branded site was gone, leaving a bare directory listing.
ACCC action (VISP/unconscionable conduct) began 2002; litigation continued to 2006.
Federal Court judgment Nov 2006, coincident with the brand's web collapse.
